newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics to demonstrates new technology. [CORRECTED 23:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics to demonstrates new technology. [CORRECTED 23:55 GMT]

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp said Wednesday it will demonstrate its fast 56 Kilobyte per second technology at COMDEX, a computer industry trade show.
(Corrects headline and first paragraph to make clear demonstration has not yet taken place)

The company, which expects to be the first company to deliver 56 Kbbs data transmission speeds over regular analog telephone lines, said the total number of Internet service providers that will support the technology has grown to nearly 40.
"We are aggressively moving ahead toward a January release of our 'x2' technology," said chairman Casey Cowell in a statement. "We expect to be the first in the marketplace with 56K technology."
U.S. Robotics supplies products and systems that provide access to information.
